name: Phenyl Aminosalicylate

similar.name: Salsalate
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for nerve and brain harm, heart harm and stomach and gut problems

summary: According to a small computer model rather than tests on people, Phenyl Aminosalicylate received low risk scores for both liver and heart problems [M]. The drug itself has no problems of its own listed in these records [1][2]. However, a similar drug called Salsalate carries a boxed warning in the United States for heart harm, nerve and brain harm, and stomach and gut problems [3].
